### Trials of Various Kinds
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/trials-various-kinds
Passage: James 1:2
Points:
- Believers are instructed to greet outward troubles and afflictions with joy rather than defeat.
- Biblical testing serves to refine and purify genuine faith rather than merely test for its presence.
- Meeting hardships faithfully develops steadfast perseverance in the Christian life.
- Faith starts small and grows stronger as God leads believers through diverse trials.
- Difficulties teach Christians not to depend on worldly hope, but to rely wholly on Christ.

### Becoming a Pearl
Author: Kelly McFadden
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/homeword/becoming-a-pearl-homeword-november-12.html
Passage: James 1:2-4
Points:
- Just as an oyster uses an irritating grain of sand to make a pearl, God uses trials to produce beauty in our lives.
- James is not asking believers to pretend pain feels pleasant, but to see hardships as opportunities for spiritual growth.
- Hard times serve as God's instrument to build endurance, character, and mature faith.
- Denying, ignoring, or fleeing from struggles keeps us from learning what God wants to teach us.
- Embracing difficulty and trusting God enables Him to complete His transforming work in us.
